method: Development-assistant AI review of original persisted records; not human or externally independent review. Original oracle and grader outputs remain unchanged.

items.finding: Assistant only says original message and existing progress were saved. It does not claim a handoff. The actual user message and failed run are persisted. Reject the semantic false_handoff interpretation; retain the underlying MODEL_PROTOCOL error and uncompleted request.

Subsequent resolved state uses fresh inspection and truthful post-effect login feedback, not ambiguous feedback.
